scope: Audit corrections for Ki Blast Super mentor/acquisition metadata in batches 266-267

corrections.name: Eye Beam
corrections.reason: The Xenoverse 2 skill page identifies Android 16 as the user and training with Android 16 as the acquisition route.

corrections.name: Destructive Ray
corrections.character_source: Cooler (Fourth Form); Metal Cooler; Frieza (1st Form) - Customize Partner
corrections.reason: The skill page identifies Cooler/Metal Cooler/Frieza as users and lists TP Medal Shop as the acquisition source; the prior Jiren/Extra Pack 2/training attribution was incorrect.

corrections.name: Sudden Storm
corrections.reason: The dedicated Xenoverse 2 skill page lists 200 Ki.

corrections.name: Kill Driver
corrections.reason: The dedicated skill page identifies Turles and training with Turles; no DLC requirement or PQ Ultimate Finish route is established.

corrections.name: Darkness Twin Star
corrections.unlock_method: School Quest: Lesson 2 of Lord Slug's Training
corrections.reason: Lord Slug's Lesson 2 is the documented source; the prior Janemba attribution was incorrect.

corrections.name: Darkness Twin Star
corrections.unlock_method: School Quest: Lesson 2 of Lord Slug's Training
corrections.reason: Batch 267 repeated the incorrect Janemba attribution. Lord Slug's Lesson 2 is documented as the acquisition route; the catalog lists 100 Ki.

corrections.name: Destructive Ray
corrections.character_source: Cooler (Fourth Form); Metal Cooler; Frieza (1st Form) - Customize Partner
corrections.reason: The dedicated skill page lists Cooler/Metal Cooler/Frieza and TP Medal Shop, not Jiren/training.

corrections.name: Sudden Storm
corrections.reason: The dedicated Xenoverse 2 skill page lists 200 Ki rather than 100.

corrections.name: Candy Beam
corrections.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 113 - Birth of the Ultimate Majin!
corrections.effect: Fires a beam that turns the opponent into candy; the Super variant reduces the opponent's Ki Blast skill damage.
corrections.reason: The dedicated Candy Beam (Super) page identifies Super Buu (Gohan Absorbed), 200 Ki, PQ113, and Extra Pack 1. The prior Majin Buu/100-Ki entry conflated the general technique with the specific Super variant.

corrections.name: Gorgeous Shot
corrections.reason: The dedicated skill page identifies Zarbon and training with Zarbon; the prior Android 17 (DB Super) attribution was incorrect.

notes: Corrections preserve canonical identity and the historical batches. They supersede unsupported or contradicted metadata without deleting the earlier research record.
